title: Rawai and Nai Harn: Phuket's Villa South, for Renters and Buyers
excerpt: Rawai is the biggest area on our books. We list 69 homes for rent there at a median of ฿90,000 a month and 68 for sale at a median of ฿14.9 million — three quarters of them villas. What it costs, and who it suits.
author: Islander Home Team
content:
Rawai and Nai Harn sit at the bottom of the island, past Chalong, where the road runs out at the sea. It is the largest area we list — 141 homes on our books this month, more than Bang Tao or Phuket Town — and the shape of it is unlike anywhere else in Phuket. Of those 141, 106 are villas. Where Kathu is a condo district, this is the villa south: low-rise, spread out, built on land rather than up in the air.

Renting in Rawai

We have 69 homes on monthly contracts here, at a median of ฿90,000 a month — and that figure needs explaining, because it is not what a one-bedroom costs. It is high because villas dominate the list. Split by what you are actually renting:

TypeListedRangeMedian
Condominium11฿18,000 – ฿90,000฿45,000
House9฿25,000 – ฿90,000฿40,000
Villa49฿50,000 – ฿800,000฿140,000

The honest warning is at the bottom of the range: only two of the 69 are under ฿25,000 a month. The cheapest is a one-bedroom at The Title for ฿18,000, and after that you are at ฿25,000 for a two-bedroom sea-view house. If your budget is ฿12,000–฿18,000, you are looking in the wrong half of the island — try Kathu or Phuket Town instead.

From ฿40,000 the choice opens up: a three-bedroom beach house at ฿40,000, a pool-access one-bedroom at the same price, or a four-bedroom villa at ฿55,000. Nineteen listings sit between ฿60,000 and ฿100,000, which is where most private-pool villas start. Thirty are above ฿100,000, running up to beachfront at ฿280,000. See them all on Rawai rentals.

Buying in Rawai

68 homes for sale, median ฿14.9 million — the highest median of any area we cover, and again it is the villas doing it. The entry point is a condominium: ฿3.39 million buys a one-bedroom, and there are five apartments under ฿6 million. Villas start at ฿4.79 million off-plan.

The real market is the middle: 34 of the 68 are between ฿10 million and ฿20 million, which in Rawai buys a finished two- to four-bedroom pool villa — ฿10.9 million, ฿12.5 million, ฿11.9 million for three bedrooms. Above ฿20 million are the sea-view and beachfront plots, up to ฿120 million. The median home here is 250 m² of living space, which is the clearest single number about this area: you are buying room. Browse Rawai for sale.

Who Rawai suits

It suits you if you want land, a pool and a view more than you want to be ten minutes from a shopping mall. The trade is real: there is no BTS-style spine down here, Central Floresta is a 30-minute drive, and the international schools are all north. In return you get Nai Harn and Ya Nui beaches, the Saturday market, a long-standing foreign community, and a pool villa for the price of a two-bedroom condo in Bang Tao.

It does not suit a tight rental budget, and it does not suit anyone who needs to be in Patong or Laguna daily. If you want the same style of home nearer the middle of the island, read our Chalong guide — the next area up, and cheaper. If the villa budget is the question, pool villas under ฿80,000 a month covers what that figure gets you island-wide.

Figures are from our own listings in November 2026 and move as stock turns over. Tell us what you are looking for and we will send what matches, including the units that have not reached the site yet.
